q: By June 30, 2027, the U.S. or Polish government officially announces the location (city or base name) of a new permanent U.S. military base in Poland
basis: Poland formally requested a new permanent base in June 2026. On September 17, President Trump said major progress had been made and that the location would be announced soon, and on September 22 President Nawrocki said the permanent base had been confirmed. On the other hand, the 2026 U.S. National Defense Strategy speaks of adjusting the U.S. force presence in Europe, and in May the United States canceled the deployment of an armored brigade to Poland.
rs: An announcement by the U.S. Department of Defense or the Polish Ministry of National Defence
